title: Birth in 1894, Eighth Ward, and family
summary: Born 24 March 1894 in the Eighth Ward; no musicians in the family except a cousin.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers

blocks.x: Yeah, I knew he went up with Oliver. Yeah. What is your birth date?
24th of March. And what year is that? 1894.
1894. And were you born right here in the middle? Right in the middle, yeah. What part of town did you come from? Downtown here?
8 Ward, yeah. This ward is, the 8 Ward. Right here.

Can you tell us anything about your family, if anyone else in your family, that is your father or any uncles or brothers or any older brothers? Anybody else that played music before you? No. No. None of them.
Outside of Franky Deuce was an off-cousin of mine. He's in his- He was a cousin, Franky Deuce.
